test.//inputs: Exclude *.e2e.ts so editing the resource-consuming suite never invalidates the default lane's cache — it never runs those files (its vitest `include` is `src/**/*.spec.ts`, see vite.config.ts) and the live-python suite now lives ONLY on the `e2e` target below.

e2e.//: RESOURCE-CONSUMING lane. REACHABILITY (2026-09-28, backlog-e2e-cache-separation): it is NOT in any `test.dependsOn` (the default lane stays fast), but it IS reached by the push/CI gate's `nx affected -t e2e` — the gate's target list is canonicalised in `tools/gate/lane-gate.mjs` (`GATE_TARGETS = ['test','e2e']`), which `.githooks/pre-push` and both CI workflows consume — and by `publish` via the conditional in `tools/nx-plugins/build/plugin.js` (`hasE2e ? ["e2e"] : []`). It is cached (`cache:true` + `inputs`) so a repeat gate run is a cache HIT, never an uncached re-run. It runs the sibling plugin.e2e.ts suite via vitest.e2e.config.ts. `dependsOn` is `^build` — the same upstream-build prerequisite the default `test` lane inherited from targetDefaults, which builds apigen-python-env (the managed interpreter the suite provisions + spawns at runtime). The suite never loads a built artifact of this package itself.
